## Functional Specification

Domain: emulator
Summary: A cycle-accurate CHIP-8 interpreter that loads ROM files and executes the complete 1970s instruction set with graphics, sound, and input.

### Requirements (MUST implement)
- Load .ch8 files up to 3583 bytes into RAM starting at 0x200
- Maintain 60 Hz timer decrements for delay and sound
- Generate 64x32 1-bit framebuffer refreshed at 60 Hz
- Emit 60 Hz buzz when sound timer > 0
- Accept 16-key hex keypad input mapped to PC keyboard

### Data Structures
- Uint8Array(4096) RAM
- Uint8Array(64*32/8) framebuffer (1 bit per pixel)
- Uint8Array(16) V0-VF general-purpose registers
- Uint16 register I (12-bit address)
- Uint16 register PC (program counter)
- Uint8 register SP (stack pointer 0-15)
- Uint16Array(16) stack
- Uint8 delay_timer (60 Hz countdown)
- Uint8 sound_timer (60 Hz countdown)
- 16-key keypad state array Uint8Array(16)

### Components
- **cpu** (complex, ~400 LOC)
  - fetch(): read big-endian 16-bit word at PC, increment PC by 2
  - decode(opcode): extract nibble fields: nnn, n, x, y, kk
  - execute(opcode): switch-case for 0x0NNN-0xFFFF
  - opcode_00E0(): clear screen
  - opcode_00EE(): return from subroutine
  - opcode_1NNN(): jump to NNN
  - opcode_2NNN(): call subroutine at NNN
  - opcode_3XKK(): skip next if VX == KK
  - opcode_4XKK(): skip next if VX != KK
  - opcode_5XY0(): skip next if VX == VY
  - REQ: Implement all 35 opcodes exactly per COSMAC VIP behavior
  - REQ: Handle 8-bit overflow/underflow for arithmetic
  - REQ: Set VF on carry/borrow for ADD/SUB
  - REQ: Set VF on pixel collision for DXYN
- **memory** (simple, ~50 LOC)
  - load_rom(Uint8Array data): copy data into RAM starting at 0x200
  - read(addr): return RAM[addr & 0xFFF]
  - write(addr, byte): RAM[addr & 0xFFF] = byte
  - REQ: Hold 4096 bytes RAM
  - REQ: Load font sprites 0-9A-F at 0x000-0x04F
  - REQ: Read/write with no wait states
- **display** (medium, ~120 LOC)
  - clear(): zero framebuffer
  - draw_sprite(x, y, height, bytes): return collision bit
  - get_pixel(x, y): return 0/1
  - set_pixel(x, y, val): XOR into buffer
  - REQ: Maintain 64x32 1-bit buffer
  - REQ: Draw 8xN sprite rows with XOR and collision detection
  - REQ: Provide 60 Hz refresh callback
- **input** (simple, ~60 LOC)
  - key_down(chip8_key): set pressed
  - key_up(chip8_key): set released
  - is_pressed(chip8_key): return bool
  - wait_key(): promise that resolves when any key pressed
  - REQ: Track 16-key hex keypad state
  - REQ: Provide blocking wait for FX0A
  - REQ: Map to PC keyboard 1-4,Q-R,A-F,Z-V
- **timers** (simple, ~40 LOC)
  - tick(): if delay_timer>0 delay_timer--, if sound_timer>0 sound_timer-- & beep
  - REQ: Decrement delay_timer at 60 Hz
  - REQ: Decrement sound_timer at 60 Hz
  - REQ: Emit buzz when sound_timer > 0
- **frontend** (medium, ~200 LOC)
  - draw_framebuffer(buffer): map 1-bit to black/white pixels
  - play_beep(): start 440 Hz tone
  - stop_beep(): silence
  - REQ: Canvas 640x320 pixels (10x scale)
  - REQ: File picker to load .ch8 ROM
  - REQ: Run/Pause/Reset buttons
  - REQ: Speed slider 1-30 MHz
  - REQ: Trace log checkbox

### Acceptance Criteria
- Executes the full COSMAC VIP CHIP-8 test suite without errors
- Pong, Space Invaders, and Tetris ROMs run at original speed
- All graphics, sound, and input behave identically to reference videos
